title: POST /api/integration/clients/{id}/extend and PATCH /api/clients/{id}/extend (200)

dry_run.description: Only in the answer to a request with dry_run: nothing was stored.

hub_remote_now.description: Right after the extension the guest's effective Home Assistant access is Hub only and its remote access is on (it holds the read-only key because of remote access). Never true on tvos, android_tv, watchos or wearos.

hub_remote_at.description: The earliest later end (UTC) of a device adjustment or of the guest access after which the guest becomes Hub only with remote access; null when hub_remote_now is true or no end leads there.

description: Answer of a guest extension. With dry_run in the request nothing is stored: the answer carries dry_run true and the expires_at the extension would set. hub_remote_now and hub_remote_at (optional, missing on older hubs) tell whether after the extension the guest is on Hub only with remote access, or from when (docs/enforcement.md §7).
